note: Fix pass 36 of pull request #296. By the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-14, an inventory is owed only for changed code that guards trust or durability: here the attach rule in runLenses and the verifier's evidence renderings. Each claim ran against its named test alone. Three first claims for review.ts:1639 named the unlock test in probing-level.test.ts and survived it; the rows name the tests that kill them. Fourteen rows first sat in a notOwed list as code that guards neither trust nor durability; fix pass 37 moved them back into mutants with a claim each, since the sampler knows no such claim. Their runs were made at bcad3c70, where review.ts lines 1620, 1724 and 2575 sit at 1622, 1726 and 2582; the rows keep the enumerated coordinates. Beyond the enumeration, the coordinator asked for the mutant that drops probesWith from selectionOf: it survived the live-writer test, which let the first run finish before the second review looked, so b977c4ff holds the first run live; the mutant then fails it (expected 0 to be greater than 0).
